items.title: 68252_Jay Cee
items.q: He wasn't a member, but the reason he wasn't because he lived on the coast, and he wrote two songs... that was Sheldon Brooks

ctx.x: Well, let's see. I can tell you one thing, though. He wasn't a member, but the reason he

wasn't because he lived on the coast, and he wrote two songs that Will Be Here As Long as There Is Time Here - and that was Sheldon Brooks, who wrote "Some of These Days" and "Dark Town Strutters Ball".
